description:
Bundle of patches for Bejeweled Classic (com.ea.gp.bej3, 4.0.0).
- Ad-free: removes advertisement placements.
- Crash-guard: injects null guards across the Java glue layer.
- Telemetry-disabled: suppresses analytics/telemetry endpoints and severs the tracking/Kinesis-Cognito chain, including consent/opt-in flags.
Developed with AI assistance; each patch statically verified at release time.
